name: LinkedIn connections export
author: Bridge
description: Import the Connections.csv you download from LinkedIn (Settings > Data privacy > Get a copy of your data).
privacy: Processed server-side inside your own account. Nothing is sent to LinkedIn.
limitations: The export contains name, URL, email (if shared), company, position and connection date only. No skills, no followers, no messages. A 1st-degree connection is recorded as mutual_connection, not as a personal relationship, and position titles become suggested (unconfirmed) tags.
